name: git-commit-helper-blevins
description: Automatically extracts ticket codes from branch names, prefixes commit messages, and formats AI-generated messages

gitCommitHelper.autoPrefix.description: Automatically prefix commit messages with ticket codes from branch names

gitCommitHelper.ticketPattern.description: Regular expression pattern to match ticket codes in branch names. Default pattern matches any letters followed by optional dash and numbers (e.g., PROJ-123, feature123, ABC-456, JIRA-789)

gitCommitHelper.autoCondenseAI.description: Automatically condense AI-generated commit messages to one-line format with ticket prefix

enumDescriptions: Smart condensing: Extract key action, handle conventional commits, and intelligently truncate
Use only the first sentence from the AI-generated message
Use only the first line from the AI-generated message
gitCommitHelper.condensingStrategy.description: Strategy for condensing AI-generated commit messages to single-line format

gitCommitHelper.autoGenerateOnStage.description: Automatically generate commit message when files are staged (requires GitHub Copilot)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
